methodology.atr: SMA of last 14 valid completed RTH true ranges, same contract only; no warmup substitution
methodology.vwap: Session 18:00 NY anchored volume-weighted HLC3 proxy; population weighted SD of HLC3, not trade-level VWAP
methodology.vcr: last 30 contiguous 1m log-return population SD / median same-clock SD from prior 20 observations, minimum 10
methodology.rvol: cumulative session volume / median same-clock cumulative volume of prior 20 complete prefixes, minimum 10
methodology.orb_volume: completed breakout bar volume / median same NY minute volume from prior 20 sessions, minimum 10
methodology.ATR_history: Invalid RTH or its immediately following TR omitted, last 14 valid TR observations required
methodology.signal_timing: Signals use completed minute bars; entry next exact-minute open. All positions flat by noon.
methodology.A: London sweep high or low 08:30-10:15, strict close back inside range, then directional VWAP close cross on same/later completed bar before 10:15; first signal per day
methodology.B: ORB5 and ORB15 separately: first close beyond completed range 09:35/09:45-11:00, volume >1.5x prior same-clock median and close on same VWAP side
methodology.C: First close with |VWAP z|>2 during 10:30-11:30, fade toward VWAP frozen at signal, only if target lies in profit direction at next open
methodology.risk: A/B SL 0.25 prior ATR and TP 0.50 prior ATR; C SL 0.25 ATR and frozen VWAP TP. Distances floored/ceiled conservatively to tick grid. Fixed, not optimized.
methodology.fills: One trade per strategy/day, independent strategies not combined portfolio. Gap SL fills worse open; gap TP capped target. Same bar SL+TP -> SL. Costs charged on every exit.
methodology.D: Overnight 18:00-09:30 high-low / prior ATR: narrow <0.5, broad >1.2, middle otherwise; conditioning four entry times and four horizons
methodology.split: Chronological trading-date halves shared across all analyses, not split by trade counts
methodology.inference: 5-trading-day circular moving-block bootstrap on daily PnL including zero-trade eligible dates; 2000 replicates; Holm across four strategy screens per quality view; exploratory, no independent holdout

limitations: Historical Dec2024–Apr2025 only, not current market signals.
No independent holdout; additional robustness probes viewed after original results.
Direction control uses same selected entries/risk distances, not a randomized independent experiment.
Cost estimates and OHLC fill model, not broker-verified execution.
HLC3 VWAP proxy; raw data, local paths and trade-level prices not published.
Strategy equities are independent screens, not an additive investment portfolio.
Broad overnight regime has only three observations; no reliable edge conclusion.
Vendor redistribution rights are not certified; only derived aggregate research exported.
